Stats

LOW_Skoona
Enforcer Skoona is a half-orc[1] employee of the Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate.

Involvement

Skoona patrols the tavern between the front door and the rear door in the kitchen. If a party member talks to her, she warns them to not break anything; as a Barbarian she can be pushed back. Cheering her up instead with specific Barbarian or Monk lines yields companion approval.

  • [BARBARIAN] Well, I'm thinking about your arms - they're like tree trunks. I approve.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • [MONK] What does it matter what anyone else thinks? You decide your own fate - no one else.  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1

Regardless of the options, she does not turn hostile and continues her patrol.

Idle banter

  • Skoona
    By Gruumsh! These customers look more ragged every day.
  • Skoona
    When my break comes, I'm going to play with the kitchen cats, I don't care what Revoor[2] says.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ Skoona is a mentioned character in  Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, where she is described a gruff female half-ogre (instead of the half-orc she is in-game). She is there to protect the other staff members, not the patrons, and does not break up a fight unless a staff member is involved.
  2. ↑ Likely referring to Roveer, this could either be intended or a typo on Larians end.
